payload.title: Inventory every Papyrus operation that uses AWS today and assign it a home
payload.description: Go through AGENTS.md, docs/, skills and the CLI's own boto3 use. Classify each operation: existing CLI, new CLI plus server API, pipeline, or break-glass with a reason. Output docs/operating-without-aws.md. It orders the remaining tasks of this epic. Known so far: router health, router pause and resume, route-row repair, Cyclotron swap, knowledge-run status and start, seed/unpublish, logs, projection, SSM.
